meeting_point: in the plaza at School and Washington Streets, between Walgreens and the Irish Famine Memorial in Downtown Crossing.
accessibility: mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines. Stroller and wheelchair accessible.
description:
Celebrate the life of Benjamin Franklin on this guided walk along his homes and haunts in Colonial Boston.

Born in Boston, he came of age in Philadelphia, and was the darling of Paris. His legacy is without measure. He was one of America's leading scientists, inventors, diplomats, humorists, and statesmen.

Uncover stories of Benjamin Franklin’s many inventions, his civic and educational impact, and his roles in the founding of the United States.
what_is_included:
- Guided 90 minute outdoor tour exploring Boston's history
- 1.1 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
